readmeExcerpt: The CUDA-Q Platform for hybrid quantum-classical computers enables integration and programming of quantum processing units (QPUs), GPUs, and CPUs in one system. This repository contains the source code for all C++ and Python tools provided by the CUDA-Q toolkit, including the nvq++ compiler, the CUDA-Q runtime, as well as a selection of integrated CPU and GPU backends for rapid application development and testing. To learn more about how to work with CUDA-Q, please take a look at the [CUDA-Q Documentation][cuda_quantum_docs]. The page also contains [installation instructions][official_install] for officially released packages.
